---
name: Feature request
about: Suggest an idea or improvement for this tool
title: "[Feature] "
labels: enhancement
assignees: ''
---

## Problem / motivation

What are you trying to do that the tool doesn't currently support well?
(e.g. "I want to compare more than 6 categories at once and the chart
colors run out", "I want incremental/cached fetches instead of a full
re-scan every time", etc.)

## Proposed solution

Describe the change you'd like to see. If it affects the CLI, config
format, or output files, please be specific (new flag name, new JSON field,
new CSV column, etc.).

## Alternatives considered

Any alternative approaches you considered, and why you preferred the one
above.

## Additional context

Links, examples, or references that would help (e.g. a relevant GitHub API
doc, a similar tool, sample output you'd expect).

---

Also happy to take a stab at implementing this yourself? See
[CONTRIBUTING.md](../../CONTRIBUTING.md) — there's a list of known
improvement ideas there too (GraphQL batching, incremental fetch, tests,
config validation) if you're looking for a starting point.
